lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saranaaee ubare har gur rakhavaaliaa ||30||
lines.translation: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Guru, and is saved. The Guru, the Lord, is his Protector. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit vaad vakhaanade maaiaa moh suaai ||
lines.translation: Reading and writing, the Pandits engage in debates and disputes; they are attached to the flavors of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, they forget the Naam. Those foolish mortals shall receive their punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੑੀ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhi keete tisai na sevanhee dedaa rijak samaai ||
lines.translation: They do not serve the One who created them, who gives sustenance to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam kaa phaahaa galahu na kateeai phir phir aavahi jaai ||
lines.translation: The noose of Death around their necks is not cut off; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satigur miliaa tin aai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaide naanak sach samaai ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, they merge into the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach vanajahi sach sevade j guramukh pairee paahi ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who fall at His Feet deal with the True Lord and serve the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur kai bhaanai je chalahi sahaje sach samaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who walk in harmony with the Guru's Will are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa vich at dukh ghanaa manamukh chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: In hope, there is very great pain; the self-willed manmukh focuses his consciousness on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhae niraas param sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs become desireless, and attain supreme peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: viche girah udaas alipat liv laaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the midst of their household, they remain detached; they are lovingly attuned to the Detached Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa sog vijog na viaapaee har bhaanaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Sorrow and separation do not cling to them at all. They are pleased with the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har setee sadaa rav rahe dhur lae milaaiaa ||31||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they remain forever immersed in the Primal Lord, who blends them with Himself. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਅਮਾਣ ਕਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ਦਿਤੀ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paraaee amaan kiu rakheeai ditee hee sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Why keep what is held in trust for another? Giving it back, peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਥੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad gur thai tikai hor thai paragat na hoi ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad rests in the Guru; it does not appear through anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੑੇ ਵਸਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਵੇਚਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)nhe vas maanak paiaa ghar ghar vechan jaai ||
lines.translation: The blind man finds a jewel, and goes from house to house selling it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa parakh na aavaee adh na palai paai ||
lines.translation: But they cannot appraise it, and they do not offer him even half a shell for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਾਂ ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਲਇਓੁ ਪਰਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je aap parakh na aavaee taa(n) paarakheeaa thaavahu laiou parakhaai ||
lines.translation: If he cannot appraise it himself, then he should have it appraised by an appraiser.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਵਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je os naal chit laae taa(n) vath lahai nau nidh palai paai ||
lines.translation: If he focuses his consciousness, then he obtains the true object, and he is blessed with the nine treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਧਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hodai dhan jag bhukhaa muaa bin satigur sojhee na hoi ||
lines.translation: The wealth is within the house, while the world is dying of hunger. Without the True Guru, no one has a clue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad seetal man tan vasai tithai sog vijog na koi ||
lines.translation: When the cooling and soothing Shabad comes to dwell in the mind and body, there is no sorrow or separation there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: vasat paraaee aap garab kare moorakh aap ganaae ||
lines.translation: The object belongs to someone else, but the fool is proud of it, and shows his shallow nature.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin boojhe kinai na paaio phir phir aavai jaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without understanding, no one obtains it; they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਰਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man anad bhaiaa miliaa har preetam sarase sajan sa(n)t piaare ||
lines.translation: My mind is in ecstasy; I have met my Beloved Lord. My beloved friends, the Saints, are delighted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur mile na vichhuRahi kabahoo j aap mele karataare ||
lines.translation: Those who are united with the Primal Lord shall never be separated again. The Creator has united them with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad raviaa gur paaiaa sagale dookh nivaare ||
lines.translation: The Shabad permeates my inner being, and I have found the Guru; all my sorrows are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾਂ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sukhadaataa sadaa salaahee a(n)tar rakhaa(n) ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: I praise forever the Lord, the Giver of peace; I keep Him enshrined deep within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh tin kee bakheelee k kare j sachai sabad savaare ||
lines.translation: How can the self-willed manmukh gossip about those who are embellished and exalted in the True Word of the Shabad?

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa dee aap pat rakhasee meraa piaaraa saranaagat pae gur duaare ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Himself preserves the honor of those who have come to the Guru's Door seeking Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh se suhele bhae mukh oojal darabaare ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are filled with joy; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: isataree purakhai bahu preet mil mohu vadhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The husband and wife are very much in love; joining together, their love increases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr nit vekhai vigasai mohi maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing on his children and his wife, the man is pleased and attached to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਸਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਧਨੁ ਚੋਰਾਇ ਆਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: des parades dhan choraai aan muhi paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Stealing the wealth of his own country and other lands, he brings it home and feeds them.
